SELECT frpm.School Name 
FROM frpm 
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
WHERE frpm.County = 'Contra Costa' 
ORDER BY satscores.NumTstTakr DESC 
LIMIT 1;

FROM frpm

SELECT s.School, s.County, st.NumTstTakr
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = SUBSTR(st.cds, 1, 10)
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY st.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.County, st.NumTstTakr
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY st.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.School Name

WHERE frpm.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.School Name
FROM frpm

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.County Name = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.School = f.`School Name`
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.County Name = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(f.Charter School Number) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, SUM(ss.NumTstTakr) AS TotalTestTakers
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores ss ON f.School Code = ss.cds
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY TotalTestTakers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.School Name, SUM(satscores.NumTstTakr) AS TotalTestTakers
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.School Name = satscores.sname
WHERE frpm.County = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY frpm.School Name
ORDER BY TotalTestTakers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.School Name, SUM(satscores.NumTstTakr) AS TotalTestTakers
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.School Name = satscores.sname
WHERE frpm.County = 'Contra Costa'
GROUP BY frpm.School Name
ORDER BY TotalTestTakers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY f.FRPM_Count DESC
LIMIT 1;
